install:
set -euo pipefail

# OS build dependencies (no NodeSource)
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
sudo apt-get update -qq
sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
  build-essential pkg-config libssl-dev curl git ca-certificates

# nvm — download script first, then execute (never pipe curl directly to bash)
NVM_INSTALL="/tmp/nvm-install-$$.sh"
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nvm-sh/nvm/v0.40.2/install.sh -o "$NVM_INSTALL"
bash "$NVM_INSTALL"
rm -f "$NVM_INSTALL"

export NVM_DIR="${HOME}/.nvm"
# shellcheck source=/dev/null
[ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"

# exec-daemon bundles Node v22; strip from PATH so nvm does not alias to "system"
export PATH="$(echo "$PATH" | tr ':' '\n' | grep -v '^/exec-daemon$' | paste -sd: -)"

nvm install
nvm alias default "$(tr -d '[:space:]' < .nvmrc)"
nvm use --silent

NVM_VER="$(nvm version)"
export PATH="$NVM_DIR/versions/node/${NVM_VER}/bin:$PATH:/exec-daemon"

# Persist Node 24 PATH for every Agent shell (exec-daemon ships Node v22)
SPIRIT_CLOUD_ENV="${HOME}/.spirit-agent-cloud-env.sh"
cat > "${SPIRIT_CLOUD_ENV}" << 'SPIRIT_CLOUD_ENV_EOF'
# Spirit Agent Cloud: nvm Node from nodejs.org, not exec-daemon bundled node
export NVM_DIR="${HOME}/.nvm"
if [ -s "${NVM_DIR}/nvm.sh" ]; then
  # shellcheck source=/dev/null
  . "${NVM_DIR}/nvm.sh"
  export PATH="$(echo "${PATH}" | tr ':' '\n' | grep -v '^/exec-daemon$' | paste -sd: -)"
  if [ -f /workspace/.nvmrc ]; then
    nvm use --silent 2>/dev/null || true
  else
    nvm use default --silent 2>/dev/null || true
  fi
  NVM_VER="$(nvm version 2>/dev/null || echo none)"
  if [ -n "${NVM_VER}" ] && [ "${NVM_VER}" != "system" ] && [ "${NVM_VER}" != "none" ]; then
    export PATH="${NVM_DIR}/versions/node/${NVM_VER}/bin:${PATH}"
  fi
  export PATH="${PATH}:/exec-daemon"
fi
if [ -s "${HOME}/.cargo/env" ]; then
  # shellcheck source=/dev/null
  . "${HOME}/.cargo/env"
fi
SPIRIT_CLOUD_ENV_EOF

SPIRIT_CLOUD_MARKER='# spirit-agent-cloud-env'
if [ -f "${HOME}/.bashrc" ] && ! grep -qF "${SPIRIT_CLOUD_MARKER}" "${HOME}/.bashrc"; then
  {
    echo ""
    echo "${SPIRIT_CLOUD_MARKER}"
    echo '[ -f "${HOME}/.spirit-agent-cloud-env.sh" ] && . "${HOME}/.spirit-agent-cloud-env.sh"'
  } >> "${HOME}/.bashrc"
fi

# pnpm via corepack (matches package.json packageManager)
corepack enable
corepack prepare pnpm@10.33.0 --activate

# Rust stable >= 1.85 (apps/cli/Cargo.toml rust-version)
if ! command -v rustc >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  RUSTUP_INIT="/tmp/rustup-init-$$.sh"
  curl -fsSL https://sh.rustup.rs -o "$RUSTUP_INIT"
  bash "$RUSTUP_INIT" -y --default-toolchain stable --component clippy
  rm -f "$RUSTUP_INIT"
fi
# shellcheck source=/dev/null
[ -s "${HOME}/.cargo/env" ] && . "${HOME}/.cargo/env"
rustup component add clippy 2>/dev/null || true

pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

# Build verification (aligned with .github/workflows/verify.yml)
pnpm turbo run build
cargo build -p spirit-agent
cargo test -p spirit-agent
cargo clippy --all-targets -p spirit-agent -- -D warnings
start:
set -euo pipefail

# Reuse persisted profile (same logic as install writes for Agent subshells)
if [ -f "${HOME}/.spirit-agent-cloud-env.sh" ]; then
  # shellcheck source=/dev/null
  . "${HOME}/.spirit-agent-cloud-env.sh"
else
  export NVM_DIR="${HOME}/.nvm"
  # shellcheck source=/dev/null
  [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"
  export PATH="$(echo "$PATH" | tr ':' '\n' | grep -v '^/exec-daemon$' | paste -sd: -)"
  if [ -f /workspace/.nvmrc ]; then
    nvm use --silent 2>/dev/null || true
  fi
  NVM_VER="$(nvm version 2>/dev/null || echo none)"
  if [ "$NVM_VER" != "system" ] && [ "$NVM_VER" != "none" ]; then
    export PATH="$NVM_DIR/versions/node/${NVM_VER}/bin:$PATH"
  fi
  export PATH="$PATH:/exec-daemon"
  # shellcheck source=/dev/null
  [ -s "${HOME}/.cargo/env" ] && . "${HOME}/.cargo/env"
fi
